title: ApiError
description: Canonical error envelope returned by every non-2xx response. Code values defined in docs/contracts/error-taxonomy.md.

message.description: Human-readable, user-safe message. Never includes secrets, raw sensitive query text, or stack traces.

traceId.description: ULID matching X-Run-Id; used to find logs.

details.description: Optional structured details. Must not include sensitive fields.
